notes: The penalties can outweigh everything. A stock can score full marks on all five positives and still fail, because the four penalties are worth more (−14) than the five positives are (+13). That is deliberate: the scanner is built to find things before they move, so a name that has already run is penalised harder than good news can reward it. Most days nothing qualifies — and that is the scanner working, not failing.

Scoring rules are fixed in the research playbook and are not changed to fit a result. Nothing here is investment advice or a prediction — every signal is tracked afterwards in the marked-to-market ledger below, including the ones that went wrong.
